# dsh-dialogue-mindmap
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) Web UI plugin that adds a **Canvas** view beside the **Chat** tab of a co
nversation. Every turn of the session is drawn as a node in a mind map, and you can branch a follow-
up from any node — inside the same session, without creating a new one.
## Features
- **Canvas tab** next to the Chat tab; click to switch between the two views of the same conversatio
n. While the Canvas is shown, the composer below is hidden and the canvas fills the remaining height

.
- **One node per turn**, laid out as a left-to-right tree. The first turn is the root; by default

each new turn hangs under the previous one.
- **Branch from any node**: select a node, type a follow
-up in the side panel and press the button (or Ctrl+Enter). The message is sent to the same session,
prefixed with a short reference to the selected turn, and the resulting turn is attached as a child

of that node. A dashed "waiting for answer" placeholder shows until the turn arrives.
- **Detail pa
nel**: clicking a node opens a side panel with the full question and the full answer (scrollable), a
button to switch back to the Chat view, and the branch input. Drag the panel's left edge to resize

it (double-click the edge to reset); the width is remembered.
- **Pan and zoom**: drag empty canvas
space to pan; mouse wheel zooms around the cursor (25%–250%); the bottom-right controls zoom out / r
ouse wheel zooms around the cursor (25%–250%); the bottom-right controls zoom out / reset / zoom in.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then refresh the Web UI and open any conversation — a **Canvas** tab appears next to **Chat**.
## Limitations
- The tree structure (which turn is a child of which node) is stored in the browser's `localStorage`
, per session. It is not synced across browsers or devices; clearing site data resets the layout to

a linear chain.
- Because branching happens inside one session, the model still sees the whole conve

rsation history; the prefix only tells it which earlier turn the follow-up builds on.
- Full questio
n/answer text in the detail panel is read from turns already loaded in the Chat view. For very old t
urns that are not loaded yet, the panel falls back to the truncated preview — scroll up in the Chat

view once to load them.
- Hiding the composer relies on the Web UI's `data-composer-seat` attribute
and may need an update if the host UI changes.
